args.body:
Summary of websites posted in 'general':
1) www.informations.com: The latest job report shows mixed news – unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, Swiss memorabilia, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. To improve it, consider adding more about yourself, such as your projects, interests or portfolio, plus some visuals and navigation to make it more engaging. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog. I like the personal touch of sharing your love of hiking. To improve it, consider adding posts about specific hikes, photos, trail tips and a way for readers to subscribe or comment. Looking forward to reading more!
